name: flow-scout
description: Run parallel read-only SubsystemDigest reconnaissance scouts with quota-aware model routing and per-scout budgets.

subsystems.description: Subsystems and repository paths to inspect in parallel.

scout_model.description: Preferred model option for scouts (default flash).

narrow_model.description: Optional faster model option for narrow <=3-file scouts (default flash_lite fallback).

scout_agent.description: Optional pinned agent profile name for heavy scouts (default self).

narrow_agent.description: Optional pinned agent profile name for narrow <=3-file scouts (defaults to scout_agent).
